newsitem.title: UK: HALMA SHARES UP ON TECHNICAL BOUNCE.
newsitem.headline: HALMA SHARES UP ON TECHNICAL BOUNCE.

text.p: Shares in UK security systems maker Halma plc climbed on Tuesday in a firm engineering sector following weakness in the stock at the end of last week, dealers said.
Halma shares rose 7-1/2p to a six-week high of 137-1/2p by 1242 GMT in volume of 530,000 shares, making it the second best performing stock amongst the top 350 UK companies.

The stock has been under a cloud since the company reported lower-than-expected profits on June 24 but dealers said improved investor sentiment towards second- tier engineering stocks lifted the shares to a six-week high.
"Halma shares look like they are getting a re-rating and everyone is trying to buy them on the same day," said one dealer.
Dealers said the softening of the sterling/mark exchange rate in the last week had been a key factor in the recovery of engineering stocks which continued on Tuesday.
Elsewhere in the sector, BBA Group Plc gained 8p to 402p, IMI Plc advanced 3-1/2p to 381p and TI Group Plc climbed 6p to 615-1/2p,
